```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r packages}
library(icorp26)
library(easystats)
library(ggplot2)
```

These are example variables, you should identify your
own variables. 

Look at the ggplot websites to learn how to change the 
colors, fonts and other details.

```{r}
data_tabulate(rss1$HIS_GENERAL) |> 
     plot(label_values = FALSE, error_bar = FALSE,
          show_na = "never") + 
     coord_flip() +
     labs(title = "Overall health")

data_tabulate(rss1$PAY_PAYWORRY) |>
     plot(label_values = FALSE, error_bar = FALSE,
          show_na = "never") + 
     coord_flip() +
     labs(title = "Worried about pay if sick/injured") 

data_tabulate(rss1$MARSTAT) |> 
     plot(label_values = FALSE, error_bar = FALSE,
          show_na = "never") + 
     coord_flip() +
     labs(title = "Marital Status")
```
